entities.name: Philippe du Bec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philippe Crespin du Bec was a French churchman of the 16th century. He was successively Bishop of Vannes (1559–1566), Bishop of Nantes (1566–1594) and Archbishop of Reims (1594–1605). Master of the King's Chapel and Commander of the Order of the Holy Spirit.
